name: redstarvibe
description: RedStarVibe full-stack learning project: .NET 10 API + React + Angular

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix client-react install && npm --prefix client-angular install
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:react && npm run test:angular
scripts.build: dotnet build server -c Release && npm --prefix client-react run build && npm --prefix client-angular run build
scripts.db:update: dotnet ef database update --project server/Server.Api -- --environment Development
scripts.db:script: dotnet ef migrations script --idempotent --project server/Server.Api -o artifacts/migrate.sql
scripts.audit: dotnet list server/Server.slnx package --vulnerable --include-transitive && npm --prefix client-react audit --omit=dev && npm --prefix client-angular audit --omit=dev
